summary: Validated IN-UI-01..04 test design against hard-gate checklist. Result is FAIL: requirement-level coverage exists but multiple mandatory isolation/self-sufficiency/security checks fail, and spec case count does not match implemented E2E test count.

tests_run.name: Artifact review: IN-UI specs and E2E source
tests_run.detail: Hard-gate violations found in fixture isolation, cleanup, credentials handling, and spec-to-test count alignment.

tests_run.name: Spec/test count validation
tests_run.detail: SPEC_TC_COUNT=8 and IMPL_TEST_COUNT=4 from PowerShell Select-String check.

issues_found.description: Spec-to-implementation gap: 8 test cases defined across IN-UI-01..04 specs but only 4 implemented requirement test blocks in Playwright file.
Fixture isolation violation: shared mutable fixtures are seeded in test.beforeAll and reused across multiple tests instead of per-test fixture setup.
No cleanup/teardown for created definitions and instances; no afterEach/afterAll cleanup guard is present to ensure cleanup on failure.
Per-test UUID requirement not met: fixture IDs and keys use Date.now()-derived strings rather than UUIDs.
Security violation: credentials are hardcoded in E2E source (KEYCLOAK_USERNAME and KEYCLOAK_PASSWORD constants).
Self-sufficiency gap: test does not start backend/Keycloak nor call a documented setup-health helper; it assumes external services are already running at localhost:8081 and API endpoints.

next_steps: Route to TEST-DESIGNER for rework of specs/tests to satisfy hard-gate checks.
Split or expand E2E tests so implemented test count matches spec case count (8/8).
Move fixture creation to per-test setup and add guaranteed cleanup in afterEach/afterAll.
Replace Date.now identifiers with UUID-based fixture keys and remove hardcoded credentials from source.
blockers: Hard-gate FAIL: Step 3b cannot pass until fixture isolation, cleanup, security, and completeness violations are resolved.
